title: Protecting Domestic Workers Across Borders
discussion_signal: The post frames migrant domestic-worker protection as a lifecycle problem spanning recruitment, sponsorship systems, and fragmented or non-portable social protection across the South Asia–GCC corridor.
linked_research_question: Which protections must travel with migrant workers across recruitment, employment, mobility, and return rather than remaining bounded by a single national system?
limits: The post describes a corridor-specific event and research agenda
It does not provide outcome estimates for all migrant workers
The discussion is institutionally framed and may underrepresent worker-led dissent
